decisive_items: Potentially revertant area epidermis: High rates of wild-type transcripts (35.0%)
compound heterozygous alterations (c.2992 + 2T>G and c.8621-30A>G) at splice sites in COL7A1
A patch of healthy skin (7.5 × 4 cm²) on the left forearm, lacking blistering
response.rationale: The healthy skin patch with high wild-type transcripts indicates revertant mosaicism, a specific phenomenon in a patient with COL7A1-related dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa. R1 names this exact diagnosis, while R2 only gives the underlying disease without the key finding.

rejected.why: Describes the underlying condition but misses the specific revertant mosaicism that explains the healthy skin patch and is the most likely diagnosis.
